tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa'i srung ma dkar bdud lcam dral dang / dam can gyi gtor chog dngos grub bsam 'phel bzhugs so// bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje phur pa sa skya pa'i lugs kyi sgos kyi chos skyong dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral dang / dam can bcu gnyis la gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ gtor ma lag len ltar bshams pa rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ kye rdor gur zhal sogs dang sbrel nas byed na/ gtor ma byin rlabs phyogs gcig byas pas chog cing / zur du byed na/ gtor ma byin rlabs phur pa'i bsnyen pa byed tshul du bshad pa bzhin bya/ gang ltar na yang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum brjod la/ byin rlabs dran par byas nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su padma dang nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du bhyoḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ dkar mo nyi zla stong gi phreng ba can sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas ri rab sgoong rdor 'phen cing / g.yon pas gling bzhi byo ldog tu mdzad pa/ nyi zla brgya yis dbu la brgyan zhing / nyi zla dgu brgyas do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar dkar po'i na bza' can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i g.yon du rta nag po'i steng du hūm̐ las bdud kyi rgyal po thod pa'i phreng ba can/ sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas pas ba dan nag po nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas rus phreng phyar stabs su 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' can/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa 'khor 'chi bdag nag po rang dang 'dra ba brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkar mo nyi zla dang /

bdud kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ che ba'i che mchog gsang ba'i gzugs/ /thig le sbyor ba'i yum gcig ma/ /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can/ /srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po yang / /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e hye hi sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma ka mā la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis oṃ badzri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing / dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' re res dbu brgyan/ de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ badzra sa mā ya satwaṃ/ badzra sa ma ya hoḥ dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod phreng 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang / rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs thams cad tshar bcad pa dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badzra shāntiṃ padma kurting bhyoḥ oṃ sarba mā ra kriṣṇa ka pā la mā la dha ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha trūṃ bighnān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa gsum mam lngas gtor ma phul/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ shāntiṃ ku ru/ puṣṭiṃ ku ru/ wa shaṃ ku ru dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/

bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bsam don chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing / g.yon pa'i srin mdzub kyi nang mchod gtor la/ bstod pa ni/ bhyoḥdapal ldan dkar mo chen mo ni/ /sngon tshe che mchog he ru ka'i/ /spyan sngar khas blang de bzhin du/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'dul ba dang / /sgrub po 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang / /bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub pa dang / /dgra bgegs thams cad sgrol ba dang / /bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /hūm̐ sngon tshe bdud kun gyi ni bdag po che/ /shin tu mi zad rdo rje khrag 'thung gi /spyan sngar dam bcas bdud rgyal thod phreng can/ /mthu rtsal rmad byung nag po che la bstod/ /dam can gyi gtor ma ni/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran par byas/ hūm̐ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar phur pa'i bsrung mar zhal bzhes pa/ /bdag nyid chen mo shwa na bse mo'i tshogs/ /dpal gyi pho nya mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can/ /dam tshig dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya dha ti ma ma shī ghraṃ karma ka ra mā ra se na pra marda ni sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ yang sa pa ri wā ra yan gyi rjes su/ i dam ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum mam lnga yi gtor ma phul la nang mchod gtor zhing / oṃ ma hā pañtsa amṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rakta khā hi/ bdag nyid ma bzhi/ shwa na ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi/ 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod par 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sogs phrin las gong bzhin bcol nas/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar phur pa'i bsrung mar zhal bzhes pa/ /bdag nyid chen po shwa na bse mo'i tshogs/ /dpal gyi pho nya mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can/

/dam can ma mo sde gsum mched bcu gnyis/ /rnam lnga rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /ma sring mdza' mo'i tshul gyi grogs mdzod cig /thugs dam rjes dgongs bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /de nas rjes kyi cho ga rnams bsnyen pa byed tshul du bshad pa ltar skabs dang sbyar la bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di ni dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bris nas mi'i dbang po sgron ma rab brtan dpal bzang po la phul ba'o// //e waṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ rdo rje phur pa'i srung ma dkar bdud lcam dral dang dam can gyi gtor chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
